> 47	// ── Formatting helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
> 48	function formatNumber(v?: string | number): string {
> 49	  const n = typeof v === 'string' ? Number(v) : v;
> 50	  if (n === undefined || n === null || Number.isNaN(n)) return '—';
> 51	  if (n >= 1_000_000) return `${(n / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`;
> 52	  if (n >= 1_000) return `${(n / 1_000).toFixed(1)}k`;
> 53	  return String(n);
> 54	}
> 55	
> 56	function formatDuration(iso?: string): string {
> 57	  if (!iso) return '—';
> 58	  const m = iso.match(/PT(?:(\d+)H)?(?:(\d+)M)?(?:(\d+)S)?/);
> 59	  if (!m) return '—';
> 60	  const h = Number(m[1] ?? 0);
> 61	  const min = Number(m[2] ?? 0);
> 62	  const s = Number(m[3] ?? 0);
> 63	  const pad = (x: number) => String(x).padStart(2, '0');
> 64	  return h > 0 ? `${h}:${pad(min)}:${pad(s)}` : `${min}:${pad(s)}`;
> 65	}
> 66	
> 67	function formatDate(iso?: string): string {
> 68	  if (!iso) return '—';
> 69	  const d = new Date(iso);
> 70	  return Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? '—' : d.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR');
> 71	}
> 72	
> 73	function formatSeconds(v?: string | number): string {
> 74	  const n = typeof v === 'string' ? Number(v) : v;
> 75	  if (n === undefined || n === null || Number.isNaN(n)) return '—';
> 76	  const min = Math.floor(n / 60);
> 77	  const s = Math.round(n % 60);
> 78	  return `${min}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
> 79	}
> 80	
> 81	function privacyBadge(status?: string) {
> 82	  const map: Record<string, string> = {
> 83	    public: 'border-cyan-500/40 text-cyan-300 bg-cyan-500/10',
> 84	    unlisted: 'border-amber-500/40 text-amber-300 bg-amber-500/10',
> 85	    private: 'border-zinc-500/40 text-zinc-300 bg-zinc-500/10',
> 86	  };
> 87	  return map[status ?? ''] ?? 'border-zinc-500/40 text-zinc-300 bg-zinc-500/10';
> 88	}
> 89	
> 90	// ── Metrics card ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
> 91	function ChannelMetrics() {
> 92	  const { data, isLoading, isError, error } = useYouTubeChannelMetrics();
> 93	
> 94	  const metrics = useMemo(() => {
> 95	    if (!data?.columnHeaders?.length || !data.rows?.length) return null;
> 96	    const row = data.rows[0];
> 97	    return Object.fromEntries(
> 98	      data.columnHeaders.map((h, i) => [h.name, row[i]]),
> 99	    ) as Record<string, string | number>;
> 100	  }, [data]);
> 101	
> 102	  if (isLoading) return <Skeleton className="h-28 w-full rounded-xl" />;
> 103	  if (isError) {
> 104	    return (
> 105	      <Card className="border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/5">
> 106	        <CardContent className="py-4 text-sm text-amber-300">
> 107	          Métricas indisponíveis: {(error as Error)?.message}
> 108	        </CardContent>
> 109	      </Card>
> 110	    );
> 111	  }
> 112	  if (!metrics) return null;
> 113	
> 114	  const gained = Number(metrics.subscribersGained ?? 0) - Number(metrics.subscribersLost ?? 0);
> 115	  const tiles = [
> 116	    { label: 'Views (28d)', value: formatNumber(metrics.views), icon: Eye },
> 117	    { label: 'Min. assistidos', value: formatNumber(metrics.estimatedMinutesWatched), icon: Clock },
> 118	    { label: 'Duração média', value: formatSeconds(metrics.averageViewDuration), icon: Clock },
> 119	    { label: '% médio assistido', value: metrics.averageViewPercentage != null ? `${Number(metrics.averageViewPercentage).toFixed(1)}%` : '—', icon: Eye },
> 120	    { label: 'Inscritos líq.', value: `${gained >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${gained}`, icon: Users },
> 121	    { label: 'Curtidas', value: formatNumber(metrics.likes), icon: ThumbsUp },
> 122	  ];
> 123	
> 124	  return (
> 125	    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6">
> 126	      {tiles.map((t) => (
> 127	        <Card key={t.label} className="bg-card/60">
> 128	          <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-1 py-4">
> 129	            <t.icon className="h-4 w-4 text-cyan-400" />
> 130	            <span className="text-xl font-semibold tabular-nums">{t.value}</span>
> 131	            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t.label}</span>
> 132	          </CardContent>
> 133	        </Card>
> 134	      ))}
> 135	    </div>
> 136	  );
> 137	}

> 139	// ── Revenue card (Fatia 2 — força o escopo yt-analytics-monetary.readonly) ──────
> 140	function RevenueCard() {
> 141	  const { data, isLoading, isError, error } = useYouTubeRevenue();
> 142	
> 143	  const money = useMemo(() => {
> 144	    if (!data || !data.monetized || !data.rows?.length) return null;
> 145	    const row = data.rows[0];
> 146	    const out: Record<string, number> = {};
> 147	    data.columnHeaders.forEach((c, i) => { out[c.name] = Number(row[i] ?? 0); });
> 148	    return out;
> 149	  }, [data]);
> 150	
> 151	  if (isLoading) return <Skeleton className="h-24 w-full rounded-xl" />;
> 152	  if (isError) {
> 153	    return (
> 154	      <Card className="border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/5">
> 155	        <CardContent className="py-4 text-sm text-amber-300">
> 156	          Não foi possível carregar a receita: {(error as Error)?.message}
> 157	        </CardContent>
> 158	      </Card>
> 159	    );
> 160	  }
> 161	  // monetized:false is a valid state — the call still proved the monetary scope.
> 162	  if (!data?.monetized || !money) {
> 163	    return (
> 164	      <Card className="bg-card/60">
> 165	        <CardContent className="flex items-center gap-3 py-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
> 166	          <DollarSign className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-400" />
> 167	          Sem dados de receita no período — o canal não está monetizado (fora do YouTube Partner Program) ou
> 168	          não gerou receita nos últimos 28 dias.
> 169	        </CardContent>
> 170	      </Card>
> 171	    );
> 172	  }
> 173	
> 174	  const fmtUsd = (v: number) => v.toLocaleString('pt-BR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' });
> 175	  const tiles = [
> 176	    { label: 'Receita estimada', value: fmtUsd(money.estimatedRevenue ?? 0) },
> 177	    { label: 'Receita de anúncios', value: fmtUsd(money.estimatedAdRevenue ?? 0) },
> 178	    { label: 'CPM', value: fmtUsd(money.cpm ?? 0) },
> 179	    { label: 'Reproduções monetizadas', value: formatNumber(money.monetizedPlaybacks ?? 0) },
> 180	  ];
> 181	  return (
> 182	    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-4">
> 183	      {tiles.map((t) => (
> 184	        <Card key={t.label} className="bg-card/60">
> 185	          <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-1 py-4">
> 186	            <DollarSign className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-400" />
> 187	            <span className="text-lg font-semibold tabular-nums">{t.value}</span>
> 188	            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t.label}</span>
> 189	          </CardContent>
> 190	        </Card>
> 191	      ))}
> 192	    </div>
> 193	  );
> 194	}

> 196	// ── Edit video dialog (Fatia 2 — força youtube.force-ssl via videos.update) ──────
> 197	function EditVideoDialog({ video, onClose }: { video: YouTubeVideo | null; onClose: () => void }) {
> 198	  const update = useUpdateVideo();
> 199	  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
> 200	  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
> 201	
> 202	  // Seed the fields when a video is opened (keyed remount via `key` on the caller keeps this simple).
> 203	  useMemo(() => {
> 204	    setTitle(video?.snippet?.title ?? '');
> 205	    setDescription(video?.snippet?.description ?? '');
> 206	  }, [video]);
> 207	
> 208	  if (!video) return null;
> 209	  const save = async () => {
> 210	    try {
> 211	      await update.mutateAsync({ videoId: video.id, title: title.trim(), description });
> 212	      toast.success('Vídeo atualizado no YouTube.');
> 213	      onClose();
> 214	    } catch (e) {
> 215	      toast.error((e as Error).message);
> 216	    }
> 217	  };
> 218	  return (
> 219	    <Dialog open={!!video} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && onClose()}>
> 220	      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-lg">
> 221	        <DialogHeader>
> 222	          <DialogTitle>Editar vídeo</DialogTitle>
> 223	          <DialogDescription>Altera o título e a descrição direto no seu canal do YouTube (videos.update).</DialogDescription>
> 224	        </DialogHeader>
> 225	        <div className="space-y-3">
> 226	          <div className="space-y-1">
> 227	            <Label htmlFor="yt-title">Título</Label>
> 228	            <Input id="yt-title" value={title} onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)} maxLength={100} />
> 229	          </div>
> 230	          <div className="space-y-1">
> 231	            <Label htmlFor="yt-desc">Descrição</Label>
> 232	            <Textarea id="yt-desc" value={description} onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)} rows={5} maxLength={5000} />
> 233	          </div>
> 234	        </div>
> 235	        <DialogFooter>
> 236	          <Button variant="outline" onClick={onClose} disabled={update.isPending}>Cancelar</Button>
> 237	          <Button onClick={save} disabled={update.isPending || !title.trim()} className="gap-2">
> 238	            {update.isPending ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <Pencil className="h-4 w-4" />}
> 239	            Salvar no YouTube
> 240	          </Button>
> 241	        </DialogFooter>
> 242	      </DialogContent>
> 243	    </Dialog>
> 244	  );
> 245	}

> 322	function VideosTable({ canWrite }: { canWrite: boolean }) {
> 323	  const { videos, isLoading, isError, error, hasNextPage, isFetchingNextPage, fetchNextPage, refetch, isRefetching } =
> 324	    useYouTubeVideos();
> 325	  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<YouTubeVideo | null>(null);
> 326	  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState<YouTubeVideo | null>(null);
> 327	  const del = useDeleteVideo();
> 328	
> 329	  const confirmDelete = async () => {
> 330	    if (!deleting) return;
> 331	    try {
> 332	      await del.mutateAsync(deleting.id);
> 333	      toast.success('Vídeo excluído permanentemente do YouTube.');
> 334	      setDeleting(null);
> 335	    } catch (e) {
> 336	      toast.error((e as Error).message);
> 337	    }
> 338	  };
> 339	
> 340	  if (isLoading) {
> 341	    return (
> 342	      <div className="space-y-2">
> 343	        {Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
> 344	          <Skeleton key={i} className="h-14 w-full rounded" />
> 345	        ))}
> 346	      </div>
> 347	    );
> 348	  }
> 349	  if (isError) {
> 350	    return (
> 351	      <Card className="border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/5">
> 352	        <CardContent className="py-4 text-sm text-amber-300">
> 353	          Não foi possível listar os vídeos: {(error as Error)?.message}
> 354	        </CardContent>
> 355	      </Card>
> 356	    );
> 357	  }
> 358	
> 359	  return (
> 360	    <Card>
> 361	      <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between gap-2">
> 362	        <div>
> 363	          <CardTitle className="text-base">Vídeos do canal ({videos.length}{hasNextPage ? '+' : ''})</CardTitle>
> 364	          <CardDescription>
> 365	            {canWrite
> 366	              ? 'Tabela completa da API + ações de edição e exclusão dos seus próprios vídeos.'
> 367	              : 'Tabela completa de propriedades da API (somente leitura).'}
> 368	          </CardDescription>
> 369	        </div>
> 370	        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => refetch()} disabled={isRefetching}>
> 371	          <RefreshCw className={`h-4 w-4 ${isRefetching ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
> 372	          Atualizar
> 373	        </Button>
> 374	      </CardHeader>
> 375	      <CardContent>
> 376	        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
> 377	          <Table>
> 378	            <TableHeader>
> 379	              <TableRow>
> 380	                {COLUMNS.map((c) => (
> 381	                  <TableHead key={c} className="whitespace-nowrap text-xs">{c}</TableHead>
> 382	                ))}
> 383	                {canWrite && <TableHead className="whitespace-nowrap text-xs">Ações</TableHead>}
> 384	              </TableRow>
> 385	            </TableHeader>
> 386	            <TableBody>
> 387	              {videos.map((v) => (
> 388	                <VideoRow key={v.id} v={v} canWrite={canWrite} onEdit={setEditing} onDelete={setDeleting} />
> 389	              ))}
> 390	            </TableBody>
> 391	          </Table>
> 392	        </div>
> 393	        {hasNextPage && (
> 394	          <div className="mt-4 flex justify-center">
> 395	            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => fetchNextPage()} disabled={isFetchingNextPage}>
> 396	              {isFetchingNextPage ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : null}
> 397	              Carregar mais
> 398	            </Button>
> 399	          </div>
> 400	        )}
> 401	      </CardContent>
> 402	
> 403	      {/* Fatia 2 — edit (keyed remount seeds the fields) + destructive delete confirmation. */}
> 404	      <EditVideoDialog key={editing?.id ?? 'none'} video={editing} onClose={() => setEditing(null)} />
> 405	      <AlertDialog open={!!deleting} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDeleting(null)}>
> 406	        <AlertDialogContent>
> 407	          <AlertDialogHeader>
> 408	            <AlertDialogTitle>Excluir vídeo permanentemente?</AlertDialogTitle>
> 409	            <AlertDialogDescription>
> 410	              "{deleting?.snippet?.title ?? deleting?.id}" será removido do seu canal do YouTube de forma
> 411	              PERMANENTE e irreversível (videos.delete). Esta ação não pode ser desfeita.
> 412	            </AlertDialogDescription>
> 413	          </AlertDialogHeader>
> 414	          <AlertDialogFooter>
> 415	            <AlertDialogCancel disabled={del.isPending}>Cancelar</AlertDialogCancel>
> 416	            <AlertDialogAction
> 417	              onClick={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); confirmDelete(); }}
> 418	              disabled={del.isPending}
> 419	              className="bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90"
> 420	            >
> 421	              {del.isPending ? <Loader2 className="mr-1 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <Trash2 className="mr-1 h-4 w-4" />}
> 422	              Excluir permanentemente
> 423	            </AlertDialogAction>
> 424	          </AlertDialogFooter>
> 425	        </AlertDialogContent>
> 426	      </AlertDialog>
> 427	    </Card>
> 428	  );
> 429	}

> 431	// ── Page ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
> 432	export default function YouTubeStudioPage() {
> 433	  const conn = useYouTubeConnection();
> 434	  const { channel } = useYouTubeChannel();
> 435	
> 436	  const header = (
> 437	    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
> 438	      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
> 439	        <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-red-600/15 text-red-400">
> 440	          <MonitorPlay className="h-6 w-6" />
> 441	        </div>
> 442	        <div>
> 443	          <h1 className="text-xl font-semibold">YouTube Studio</h1>
> 444	          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
> 445	            {conn.channelTitle ? `Canal conectado: ${conn.channelTitle}` : 'Gestão do canal conectado ao MCORCH'}
> 446	          </p>
> 447	        </div>
> 448	      </div>
> 449	      {channel?.snippet?.customUrl && (
> 450	        <a
> 451	          href={`https://youtube.com/${channel.snippet.customUrl}`}
> 452	          target="_blank"
> 453	          rel="noreferrer"

> 456	          {channel.snippet.customUrl} <ExternalLink className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
> 457	        </a>
> 458	      )}
> 459	    </div>
> 460	  );
> 461	
> 462	  if (conn.isLoading) {
> 463	    return (
> 464	      <div className="space-y-6 p-6">
> 465	        {header}
> 466	        <Skeleton className="h-28 w-full rounded-xl" />
> 467	      </div>
> 468	    );
> 469	  }
> 470	
> 471	  // Not connected → connect CTA
> 472	  if (!conn.isConnected) {
> 473	    return (
> 474	      <div className="space-y-6 p-6">
> 475	        {header}
> 476	        <Card className="border-cyan-500/20">
> 477	          <CardContent className="flex flex-col items-center gap-4 py-12 text-center">
> 478	            <Link2 className="h-10 w-10 text-cyan-400" />
> 479	            <div>
> 480	              <p className="font-medium">Nenhum canal do YouTube conectado</p>
> 481	              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
> 482	                Conecte o canal para ler vídeos e métricas diretamente no MCORCH.
> 483	              </p>
> 484	            </div>
> 485	            <Button onClick={conn.connect} className="gap-2">
> 486	              <MonitorPlay className="h-4 w-4" /> Conectar YouTube
> 487	            </Button>
> 488	          </CardContent>
> 489	        </Card>
> 490	      </div>
> 491	    );
> 492	  }
> 493	
> 494	  // Connected but missing read/analytics scopes → reconnect CTA (fail-closed, no API call fired)
> 495	  if (conn.needsReconnect) {
> 496	    return (
> 497	      <div className="space-y-6 p-6">
> 498	        {header}
> 499	        <Card className="border-amber-500/40 bg-amber-500/5">
> 500	          <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-4 py-8">
> 501	            <div className="flex items-start gap-3">

\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\nfunction formatNumber(v?: string | number): string {\n  const n = typeof v === 'string' ? Number(v) : v;\n  if (n === undefined || n === null || Number.isNaN(n)) return '\u2014';\n  if (n >= 1_000_000) return `${(n / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`;\n  if (n >= 1_000) return `${(n / 1_000).toFixed(1)}k`;\n  return String(n);\n}\n\nfunction formatDuration(iso?: string): string {\n  if (!iso) return '\u2014';\n  const m = iso.match(/PT(?:(\\d+)H)?(?:(\\d+)M)?(?:(\\d+)S)?/);\n  if (!m) return '\u2014';\n  const h = Number(m[1] ?? 0);\n  const min = Number(m[2] ?? 0);\n  const s = Number(m[3] ?? 0);\n  const pad = (x: number) => String(x).padStart(2, '0');\n  return h > 0 ? `${h}:${pad(min)}:${pad(s)}` : `${min}:${pad(s)}`;\n}\n\nfunction formatDate(iso?: string): string {\n  if (!iso) return '\u2014';\n  const d = new Date(iso);\n  return Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? '\u2014' : d.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR');\n}\n\nfunction formatSeconds(v?: string | number): string {\n  const n = typeof v === 'string' ? Number(v) : v;\n  if (n === undefined || n === null || Number.isNaN(n)) return '\u2014';\n  const min = Math.floor(n / 60);\n  const s = Math.round(n % 60);\n  return `${min}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;\n}\n\nfunction privacyBadge(status?: string) {\n  const map: Record<string, string> = {\n    public: 'border-cyan-500/40 text-cyan-300 bg-cyan-500/10',\n    unlisted: 'border-amber-500/40 text-amber-300 bg-amber-500/10',\n    private: 'border-zinc-500/40 text-zinc-300 bg-zinc-500/10',\n  };\n  return map[status ?? ''] ?? 'border-zinc-500/40 text-zinc-300 bg-zinc-500/10';\n}\n\n// \u2500\u2500 Metrics card \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\nfunction ChannelMetrics() {\n  const { data, isLoading, isError, error } = useYouTubeChannelMetrics();\n\n  const metrics = useMemo(() => {\n    if (!data?.columnHeaders?.length || !data.rows?.length) return null;\n    const row = data.rows[0];\n    return Object.fromEntries(\n      data.columnHeaders.map((h, i) => [h.name, row[i]]),\n    ) as Record<string, string | number>;\n  }, [data]);\n\n  if (isLoading) return <Skeleton className=\"h-28 w-full rounded-xl\" />;\n  if (isError) {\n    return (\n      <Card className=\"border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/5\">\n        <CardContent className=\"py-4 text-sm text-amber-300\">\n          M\u00e9tricas indispon\u00edveis: {(error as Error)?.message}\n        </CardContent>\n      </Card>\n    );\n  }\n  if (!metrics) return null;\n\n  const gained = Number(metrics.subscribersGained ?? 0) - Number(metrics.subscribersLost ?? 0);\n  const tiles = [\n    { label: 'Views (28d)', value: formatNumber(metrics.views), icon: Eye },\n    { label: 'Min. assistidos', value: formatNumber(metrics.estimatedMinutesWatched), icon: Clock },\n    { label: 'Dura\u00e7\u00e3o m\u00e9dia', value: formatSeconds(metrics.averageViewDuration), icon: Clock },\n    { label: '% m\u00e9dio assistido', value: metrics.averageViewPercentage != null ? `${Number(metrics.averageViewPercentage).toFixed(1)}%` : '\u2014', icon: Eye },\n    { label: 'Inscritos l\u00edq.', value: `${gained >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${gained}`, icon: Users },\n    { label: 'Curtidas', value: formatNumber(metrics.likes), icon: ThumbsUp },\n  ];\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6\">\n      {tiles.map((t) => (\n        <Card key={t.label} className=\"bg-card/60\">\n          <CardContent className=\"flex flex-col gap-1 py-4\">\n            <t.icon className=\"h-4 w-4 text-cyan-400\" />\n            <span className=\"text-xl font-semibold tabular-nums\">{t.value}</span>\n            <span className=\"text-xs text-muted-foreground\">{t.label}</span>\n          </CardContent>\n        </Card>\n      ))}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\n// \u2500\u2500 Revenue card (Fatia 2 \u2014 for\u00e7a o escopo yt-analytics-monetary.readonly) \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\nfunction RevenueCard() {\n  const { data, isLoading, isError, error } = useYouTubeRevenue();\n\n  const money = useMemo(() => {\n    if (!data || !data.monetized || !data.rows?.length) return null;\n    const row = data.rows[0];\n    const out: Record<string, number> = {};\n    data.columnHeaders.forEach((c, i) => { out[c.name] = Number(row[i] ?? 0); });\n    return out;\n  }, [data]);\n\n  if (isLoading) return <Skeleton className=\"h-24 w-full rounded-xl\" />;\n  if (isError) {\n    return (\n      <Card className=\"border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/5\">\n        <CardContent className=\"py-4 text-sm text-amber-300\">\n          N\u00e3o foi poss\u00edvel carregar a receita: {(error as Error)?.message}\n        </CardContent>\n      </Card>\n    );\n  }\n  // monetized:false is a valid state \u2014 the call still proved the monetary scope.\n  if (!data?.monetized || !money) {\n    return (\n      <Card className=\"bg-card/60\">\n        <CardContent className=\"flex items-center gap-3 py-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground\">\n          <DollarSign className=\"h-4 w-4 text-emerald-400\" />\n          Sem dados de receita no per\u00edodo \u2014 o canal n\u00e3o est\u00e1 monetizado (fora do YouTube Partner Program) ou\n          n\u00e3o gerou receita nos \u00faltimos 28 dias.\n        </CardContent>\n      </Card>\n    );\n  }\n\n  const fmtUsd = (v: number) => v.toLocaleString('pt-BR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' });\n  const tiles = [\n    { label: 'Receita estimada', value: fmtUsd(money.estimatedRevenue ?? 0) },\n    { label: 'Receita de an\u00fancios', value: fmtUsd(money.estimatedRevenue ?? 0)) },\n    { label: 'Receita de an\u00fancios', value: fmtUsd(money.estimatedAdRevenue ?? 0) },\n    { label: 'CPM', value: fmtUsd(money.cpm ?? 0) },\n    { label: 'Reprodu\u00e7\u00f5es monetizadas', value: formatNumber(money.monetizedPlaybacks ?? 0) },\n  ];\n  return (\n    <div className=\"grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-4\">\n      {tiles.map((t) => (\n        <Card key={t.label} className=\"bg-card/60\">\n          <CardContent className=\"flex flex-col gap-1 py-4\">\n            <DollarSign className=\"h-4 w-4 text-emerald-400\" />\n            <span className=\"text-lg font-semibold tabular-nums\">{t.value}</span>\n            <span className=\"text-xs text-muted-foreground\">{t.label}</span>\n          </CardContent>\n        </Card>\n      ))}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\n// \u2500\u2500 Edit video dialog (Fatia 2 \u2014 for\u00e7a youtube.force-ssl via videos.update) \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\nfunction EditVideoDialog({ video, onClose }: { video: YouTubeVideo | null; onClose: () => void }) {\n  const update = useUpdateVideo();\n  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');\n  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');\n\n  // Seed the fields when a video is opened (keyed remount via `key` on the caller keeps this simple).\n  useMemo(() => {\n    setTitle(video?.snippet?.title ?? '');\n    setDescription(video?.snippet?.description ?? '');\n  }, [video]);\n\n  if (!video) return null;\n  const save = async () => {\n    try {\n      await update.mutateAsync({ videoId: video.id, title: title.trim(), description });\n      toast.success('V\u00eddeo atualizado no YouTube.');\n      onClose();\n    } catch (e) {\n      toast.error((e as Error).message);\n    }\n  };\n  return (\n    <Dialog open={!!video} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && onClose()}>\n      <DialogContent className=\"sm:max-w-lg\">\n        <DialogHeader>\n          <DialogTitle>Editar v\u00eddeo</DialogTitle>\n          <DialogDescription>Altera o t\u00edtulo e a descri\u00e7\u00e3o direto no seu canal do YouTube (videos.update).</DialogDescription>\n        </DialogHeader>\n        <div className=\"space-y-3\">\n          <div className=\"space-y-1\">\n            <Label htmlFor=\"yt-title\">T\u00edtulo</Label>\n            <Input id=\"yt-title\" value={title} onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)} maxLength={100} />\n          </div>\n          <div className=\"space-y-1\">\n            <Label htmlFor=\"yt-desc\">Descri\u00e7\u00e3o</Label>\n            <Textarea id=\"yt-desc\" value={description} onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)} rows={5} maxLength={5000} />\n          </div>\n        </div>\n        <DialogFooter>\n          <Button variant=\"outline\" onClick={onClose} disabled={update.isPending}>Cancelar</Button>\n          <Button variant=\"outline\" onClick={onClose} disabled={update.isPending}>Cancelar</Button>\n          <Button onClick={save} disabled={update.isPending || !title.trim()} className=\"gap-2\">\n            {update.isPending ? <Loader2 className=\"h-4 w-4 animate-spin\" /> : <Pencil className=\"h-4 w-4\" />}\n            Salvar no YouTube\n          </Button>\n        </DialogFooter>\n      </DialogContent>\n    </Dialog>\n  );\n}\n\n// \u2500\u2500 Videos table \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\nconst COLUMNS = [\n  'V\u00eddeo', 'Publicado', 'Privacidade', 'Upload', 'Dura\u00e7\u00e3o', 'Def',\n  'Views', 'Likes', 'Coment.', 'Tags', 'Cat.', 'Kids', 'Licen\u00e7a', 'Embed', 'Sint\u00e9tico', 'ID',\n];\n\nfunction VideoRow({\n  v, canWrite, onEdit, onDelete,\n}: {\n  v: YouTubeVideo;\n  canWrite: boolean;\n  onEdit: (v: YouTubeVideo) => void;\n  onDelete: (v: YouTubeVideo) => void;\n}) {\n  const thumb = v.snippet?.thumbnails?.default?.url ?? v.snippet?.thumbnails?.medium?.url;\n  return (\n    <TableRow>\n      <TableCell className=\"min-w-[280px]\">\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3\">\n          {thumb ? (\n            <img src={thumb} alt=\"\" className=\"h-10 w-16 flex-shrink-0 rounded object-cover\" loading=\"lazy\" />\n          ) : (\n            <div className=\"h-10 w-16 flex-shrink-0 rounded bg-muted\" />\n          )}\n          <div className=\"min-w-0\">\n            {/* O t\u00edtulo navega para a p\u00e1gina de an\u00e1lise do v\u00eddeo (interna), n\u00e3o para o YouTube. */}\n            <Link\n              to={`/dashboard/youtube/studio-yt/video/${v.id}`}\n              className=\"line-clamp-2 text-sm font-medium hover:text-cyan-300\"\n            >\n              {v.snippet?.title ?? '(sem t\u00edtulo)'}\n            </Link>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      </TableCell>\n      <TableCell className=\"whitespace-nowrap text-xs text-muted-foreground\">{formatDate(v.snippet?.publishedAt)}</TableCell>\n      <TableCell>\n        <Badge variant=\"outline\" className={privacyBadge(v.status?.privacyStatus)}>\n          {v.status?.privacyStatus ?? '\u2014'}\n        </Badge>\n      </TableCell>\n      <TableCell className=\"whitespace-nowrap text-xs\">{v.status?.uploadStatus ?? '\u2014'}</TableCell>\n      <TableCell className=\"whitespace-nowrap tabular-nums text-xs\">{formatDuration(v.contentDetails?.duration)}</TableCell>\n      <TableCell className=\"text-xs uppercase\">{v.contentDetails?.definition ?? '\u2014'}</TableCell>\n      <TableCell className=\"tabular-nums\">{formatNumber(v.statistics?.viewCount)}</TableCell>\n      <TableCell className=\"tabular-nums\">{formatNumber(v.statistics?.likeCount)}</TableCell>\n      <TableCell className=\"tabular-nums\">{formatNumber(v.statistics?.commentCount)}</TableCell>\n      <TableCell className=\"tabular-nums text-xs\">{v.snippet?.tags?.length ?? 0}</TableCell>\n      <TableCell className=\"text-xs\">{v.snippet?.categoryId ?? '\u2014'}</TableCell>\n      <TableCell className=\"text-xs\">{v.status?.madeForKids ? 'Sim' : 'N\u00e3o'}</TableCell>\n      <TableCell className=\"text-xs\">{v.status?.license ?? '\u2014'}</TableCell>\n      <TableCell className=\"text-xs\">{v.status?.embeddable ? 'Sim' : 'N\u00e3o'}</TableCell>\n      <TableCell className=\"text-xs\">{v.status?.containsSyntheticMedia ? 'Sim' : '\u2014'}</TableCell>\n      <TableCell className=\"font-mono text-[10px] text-muted-foreground\">{v.id}</TableCell>\n      {canWrite && (\n        <TableCell className=\"whitespace-nowrap\">\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1\">\n            <Button variant=\"ghost\" size=\"icon\" className=\"h-7 w-7\" title=\"Editar\" onClick={() => onEdit(v)}>\n              <Pencil className=\"h-3.5 w-3.5\" />\n            </Button>\n            <Button\n              variant=\"ghost\" size=\"icon\"\n              className=\"h-7 w-7 text-destructive hover:text-destructive\"\n              title=\"Excluir permanentemente\"\n              onClick={() => onDelete(v)}\n            >\n              <Trash2 className=\"h-3.5 w-3.5\" />\n            </Button>\n          </div>\n        </TableCell>\n      )}\n    </TableRow>\n  );\n}\n\nfunction VideosTable({ canWrite }: { canWrite: boolean }) {\n  const { videos, isLoading, isError, error, hasNextPage, isFetchingNextPage, fetchNextPage, refetch, isRefetching } =\n    useYouTubeVideos();\n  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<YouTubeVideo | null>(null);\n  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState<YouTubeVideo | null>(null);\n  const del = useDeleteVideo();\n\n  const confirmDelete = async () => {\n    if (!deleting) return;\n    try {\n      await del.mutateAsync(deleting.id);\n      toast.success('V\u00eddeo exclu\u00eddo permanentemente do YouTube.');\n      setDeleting(null);\n    } catch (e) {\n      toast.error((e as Error).message);\n    }\n  };\n\n  if (isLoading) {\n    return (\n      <div className=\"space-y-2\">\n        {Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (\n          <Skeleton key={i} className=\"h-14 w-full rounded\" />\n        ))}\n      </div>\n    );\n  }\n  if (isError) {\n    return (\n      <Card className=\"border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/5\">\n        <CardContent className=\"py-4 text-sm text-amber-300\">\n          N\u00e3o foi poss\u00edvel listar os v\u00eddeos: {(error as Error)?.message}\n        </CardContent>\n      </Card>\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <Card>\n      <CardHeader className=\"flex flex-row items-center justify-between gap-2\">\n        <div>\n          <CardTitle className=\"text-base\">V\u00eddeos do canal ({videos.length}{hasNextPage ? '+' : ''})</CardTitle>\n          <CardDescription>\n            {canWrite\n              ? 'Tabela completa da API + a\u00e7\u00f5es de edi\u00e7\u00e3o e exclus\u00e3o dos seus pr\u00f3prios v\u00eddeos.'\n              : 'Tabela completa de propriedades da API (somente leitura).'}\n          </CardDescription>\n        </div>\n        <Button variant=\"outline\" size=\"sm\" onClick={() => refetch()} disabled={isRefetching}>\n          <RefreshCw className={`h-4 w-4 ${isRefetching ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />\n          Atualizar\n        </Button>\n      </CardHeader>\n      <CardContent>\n        <div className=\"overflow-x-auto\">\n          <Table>\n            <TableHeader>\n              <TableRow>\n                {COLUMNS.map((c) => (\n                  <TableHead key={c} className=\"whitespace-nowrap text-xs\">{c}</TableHead>\n                ))}\n                {canWrite && <TableHead className=\"whitespace-nowrap text-xs\">A\u00e7\u00f5es</TableHead>}\n              </TableRow>\n            </TableHeader>\n            <TableBody>\n              {videos.map((v) => (\n                <VideoRow key={v.id} v={v} canWrite={canWrite} onEdit={setEditing} onDelete={setDeleting} />\n              ))}\n            </TableBody>\n          </Table>\n        </div>\n        {hasNextPage && (\n          <div className=\"mt-4 flex justify-center\">\n            <Button variant=\"outline\" onClick={() => fetchNextPage()} disabled={isFetchingNextPage}>\n              {isFetchingNextPage ? <Loader2 className=\"h-4 w-4 animate-spin\" /> : null}\n              Carregar mais\n            </Button>\n          </div>\n        )}\n      </CardContent>\n\n      {/* Fatia 2 \u2014 edit (keyed remount seeds the fields) + destructive delete confirmation. */}\n      <EditVideoDialog key={editing?.id ?? 'none'} video={editing} onClose={() => setEditing(null)} />\n      <AlertDialog open={!!deleting} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDeleting(null)}>\n        <AlertDialogContent>\n          <AlertDialogHeader>\n            <AlertDialogTitle>Excluir v\u00eddeo permanentemente?</AlertDialogTitle>\n            <AlertDialogDescription>\n              \"{deleting?.snippet?.title ?? deleting?.id}\" ser\u00e1 removido do seu canal do YouTube de forma\n              PERMANENTE e irrevers\u00edvel (videos.delete). Esta a\u00e7\u00e3o n\u00e3o pode ser desfeita.\n            </AlertDialogDescription>\n          </AlertDialogHeader>\n          <AlertDialogFooter>\n            <AlertDialogCancel disabled={del.isPending}>Cancelar</AlertDialogCancel>\n            <AlertDialogAction\n              onClick={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); confirmDelete(); }}\n              disabled={del.isPending}\n              className=\"bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90\"\n            >\n              {del.isPending ? <Loader2 className=\"mr-1 h-4 w-4 animate-spin\" /> : <Trash2 className=\"mr-1 h-4 w-4\" />}\n              Excluir permanentemente\n            </AlertDialogAction>\n          </AlertDialogFooter>\n        </AlertDialogContent>\n      </AlertDialog>\n    </Card>\n  );\n}\n\n// \u2500\u2500 Page \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\nexport default function YouTubeStudioPage() {\n  const conn = useYouTubeConnection();\n  const { channel } = useYouTubeChannel();\n\n  // Modal state\n  const [pubOpen, setPubOpen] = useState(false);\n  const [pubTab, setPubTab] = useState<'video' | 'shorts' | 'historico'>('video');\n\n  const header = (\n    <div className=\"flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3\">\n      <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3\">\n        <div className=\"flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-red-600/15 text-red-400\">\n          <MonitorPlay className=\"h-6 w-6\" />\n        </div>\n        <div>\n          <h1 className=\"text-xl font-semibold\">YouTube Studio</h1>\n          <p className=\"text-sm text-muted-foreground\">\n            {conn.channelTitle ? `Canal conectado: ${conn.channelTitle}` : 'Gest\u00e3o do canal conectado ao MCORCH'}\n          </p>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n      <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n        <Button variant=\"outline\" size=\"sm\" onClick={() => {\n          setPubTab('video');\n          setPubOpen(true);\n        }}>\n          Publicar\n        </Button>\n        <Button variant=\"outline\" size=\"sm\" onClick={() => {\n          setPubTab('historico');\n          setPubOpen(true);\n        }}>\n          Hist\u00f3rico\n        </Button>\n      </div>\n      {channel?.snippet?.customUrl && (\n        <a\n          href={`https://youtube.com/${channel.snippet.customUrl}`}\n          target=\"_blank\"\n          rel=\"noreferrer\"\n          className=\"inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-cyan-300 hover:underline\"\n        >\n          {channel.snippet.customUrl} <ExternalLink className=\"h-3.5 w-3.5\" />\n        </a>\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n\n  if (conn.isLoading) {\n    return (\n      <div className=\"space-y-6 p-6\">\n        {header}\n        <Skeleton className=\"h-28 w-full rounded-xl\" />\n        <YouTubePublishModal open={pubOpen} onOpenChange={setPubOpen} defaultTab={pubTab} />\n      </div>\n    );\n  }\n\n  // Not connected \u2192 connect CTA\n  if (!conn.isConnected) {\n    return (\n      <div className=\"space-y-6 p-6\">\n        {header}\n        <Card className=\"border-cyan-500/20\">\n          <CardContent className=\"flex flex-col items-center gap-4 py-12 text-center\">\n            <Link2 className=\"h-10 w-10 text-cyan-400\" />\n            <div>\n              <p className=\"font-medium\">Nenhum canal do YouTube conectado</p>\n              <p className=\"text-sm text-muted-foreground\">\n                Conecte o canal para ler v\u00eddeos e m\u00e9tricas diretamente no MCORCH.\n              </p>\n            </div>\n            <Button onClick={conn.connect} className=\"gap-2\">\n              <MonitorPlay className=\"h-4 w-4\" /> Conectar YouTube\n            </Button>\n          </CardContent>\n        </Card>\n        <YouTubePublishModal open={pubOpen} onOpenChange={setPubOpen} defaultTab={pubTab} />\n      </div>\n    );\n  }\n\n  // Connected but missing read/analytics scopes \u2192 reconnect CTA (fail-closed, no API call fired)\n  if (conn.needsReconnect) {\n    return (\n      <div className=\"space-y-6 p-6\">\n        {header}\n        <Card className=\"border-amber-500/40 bg-amber-500/5\">\n          <CardContent className=\"flex flex-col gap-4 py-8\">\n            <div className=\"flex items-start gap-3\">\n              <AlertTriangle className=\"mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 flex-shrink-0 text-amber-400\" />\n              <div className=\"space-y-1\">\n                <p className=\"font-medium text-amber-200\">Permiss\u00f5es insuficientes para ler o canal</p>\n                <p className=\"text-sm text-amber-200/80\">\n                  A conex\u00e3o atual s\u00f3 permite publicar. Para listar os v\u00eddeos do canal, reconecte\n                  concedendo a permiss\u00e3o de leitura do YouTube.\n                </p>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n            <div>\n              <Button onClick={conn.reconnect} className=\"gap-2\">\n                <RefreshCw className=\"h-4 w-4\" /> Reconectar com permiss\u00f5es ampliadas\n              </Button>\n > 47	// ── Formatting helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
> 48	function formatNumber(v?: string | number): string {
> 49	  const n = typeof v === 'string' ? Number(v) : v;
> 50	  if (n === undefined || n === null || Number.isNaN(n)) return '—';
> 51	  if (n >= 1_000_000) return `${(n / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`;
> 52	  if (n >= 1_000) return `${(n / 1_000).toFixed(1)}k`;
> 53	  return String(n);
> 54	}
> 55	
> 56	function formatDuration(iso?: string): string {
> 57	  if (!iso) return '—';
> 58	  const m = iso.match(/PT(?:(\d+)H)?(?:(\d+)M)?(?:(\d+)S)?/);
> 59	  if (!m) return '—';
> 60	  const h = Number(m[1] ?? 0);
> 61	  const min = Number(m[2] ?? 0);
> 62	  const s = Number(m[3] ?? 0);
> 63	  const pad = (x: number) => String(x).padStart(2, '0');
> 64	  return h > 0 ? `${h}:${pad(min)}:${pad(s)}` : `${min}:${pad(s)}`;
> 65	}
> 66	
> 67	function formatDate(iso?: string): string {
> 68	  if (!iso) return '—';
> 69	  const d = new Date(iso);
> 70	  return Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? '—' : d.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR');
> 71	}
> 72	
> 73	function formatSeconds(v?: string | number): string {
> 74	  const n = typeof v === 'string' ? Number(v) : v;
> 75	  if (n === undefined || n === null || Number.isNaN(n)) return '—';
> 76	  const min = Math.floor(n / 60);
> 77	  const s = Math.round(n % 60);
> 78	  return `${min}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
> 79	}

> 32	// ── Formatting helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
> 33	function formatNumber(v?: string | number): string {
> 34	  const n = typeof v === 'string' ? Number(v) : v;
> 35	  if (n === undefined || n === null || Number.isNaN(n)) return '—';
> 36	  if (n >= 1_000_000) return `${(n / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`;
> 37	  if (n >= 1_000) return `${(n / 1_000).toFixed(1)}k`;
> 38	  return String(n);
> 39	}
> 40	
> 41	function formatDuration(iso?: string): string {
> 42	  if (!iso) return '—';
> 43	  const m = iso.match(/PT(?:(\d+)H)?(?:(\d+)M)?(?:(\d+)S)?/);
> 44	  if (!m) return '—';
> 45	  const h = Number(m[1] ?? 0);
> 46	  const min = Number(m[2] ?? 0);
> 47	  const s = Number(m[3] ?? 0);
> 48	  const pad = (x: number) => String(x).padStart(2, '0');
> 49	  return h > 0 ? `${h}:${pad(min)}:${pad(s)}` : `${min}:${pad(s)}`;
> 50	}
> 51	
> 52	function formatDate(iso?: string): string {
> 53	  if (!iso) return '—';
> 54	  const d = new Date(iso);
> 55	  return Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? '—' : d.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR');
> 56	}
> 57	
> 58	function formatSeconds(v?: string | number): string {
> 59	  const n = typeof v === 'string' ? Number(v) : v;
> 60	  if (n === undefined || n === null || Number.isNaN(n)) return '—';
> 61	  const min = Math.floor(n / 60);
> 62	  const s = Math.round(n % 60);
> 63	  return `${min}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
> 64	}
> 65	
> 66	function privacyBadge(status?: string) {
> 67	  const map: Record<string, string> = {
> 68	    public: 'border-cyan-500/40 text-cyan-300 bg-cyan-500/10',
> 69	    unlisted: 'border-amber-500/40 text-amber-300 bg-amber-500/10',
> 70	    private: 'border-zinc-500/40 text-zinc-300 bg-zinc-500/10',
> 71	  };
> 72	  return map[status ?? ''] ?? 'border-zinc-500/40 text-zinc-300 bg-zinc-500/10';
> 73	}

### DOCUMENTATION CREDENTIAL RULE (invariant — never violate)

**When writing HANDOFF.md, README.md, or any committed documentation:**

- ✅ DO: describe WHERE a credential is stored → `VITE_GEMINI_API_KEY` is set in `.env` (local) and `GEMINI_API_KEY` in the Supabase vault
- ✅ DO: reference digest/fingerprint if useful → `GEMINI_API_KEY (digest 0fe0e159...)`
- 🔴 NEVER: include the actual credential value → `AIzaSyBv...`, `sk-...`, `eyJ...`

> **Rationale:** Phase 1 scans changes that predate the HANDOFF.md write. Any credential embedded
> in HANDOFF.md during Phase 5 escapes Phase 1 entirely and goes directly to the remote.
> This rule is the primary prevention layer; Phase 5b is the detection backstop.

## PHASE 6 — BoK SEAL STATUS (mandatory before push)

**Verify any significant module work in this session has a sealed BoK suite per CLAUDE.md MCORCH Master Execution Protocol.**

```bash
# 6-1. List BoK suites present + check completeness
for slug in $(ls docs/bok/ 2>/dev/null); do
  required=(00-index 01-mrd 02-brd 03-prd 04-frd 05-sdd 06-data-model 07-process-flow 08-quality-metrics)
  missing=()
  for doc in "${required[@]}"; do
    [ -f "docs/bok/$slug/$doc.md" ] || missing+=("$doc")
  done
  [ ${#missing[@]} -eq 0 ] \
    && echo "✅ $slug — BoK complete (9 docs)" \
    || echo "⚠️ $slug — incomplete (missing: ${missing[*]})"
done

# 6-2. Check session touched code in new src/pages/ or new supabase/functions/ that lacks BoK
session_new_modules=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~10..HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^(src/pages/|supabase/functions/|src/components/[A-Z])" | awk -F/ '{print $1"/"$2}' | sort -u)
echo "Session touched modules: $session_new_modules"

# 6-3. Mesh seal nodes for sealed BoK suites
source .env 2>/dev/null
if [ -n "$SB_SECRET_KEY" ]; then
  curl -s "$SUPABASE_URL/rest/v1/mcorch_nodes?node_type=eq.documentation_suite&select=id,name,stability_score,created_at" \
    -H "apikey: $SB_SECRET_KEY" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $SB_SECRET_KEY" \
    | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(f\"  🌐 {n['name']} ({n['stability_score']})\") for n in d]" 2>/dev/null \
    || echo "  ⚠️ Could not query seal nodes"
fi
```

**Gate verdict:**
- ✅ All session modules have sealed BoK → proceed to Phase 7 push.
- ⚠️ Module work without BoK (e.g. `feat:` commit creating new page/edge fn without `docs/bok/<slug>/`)

// ── Formatting helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function formatNumber(v?: string | number): string {
  const n = typeof v === 'string' ? Number(v) : v;
  if (n === undefined || n === null || Number.isNaN(n)) return '—';
  if (n >= 1_000_000) return `${(n / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`;
  if (n >= 1_000) return `${(n / 1_000).toFixed(1)}k`;
  return String(n);
}

function formatDuration(iso?: string): string {
  if (!iso) return '—';
  const m = iso.match(/PT(?:(\d+)H)?(?:(\d+)M)?(?:(\d+)S)?/);
  if (!m) return '—';
  const h = Number(m[1] ?? 0);
  const min = Number(m[2] ?? 0);
  const s = Number(m[3] ?? 0);
  const pad = (x: number) => String(x).padStart(2, '0');
  return h > 0 ? `${h}:${pad(min)}:${pad(s)}` : `${min}:${pad(s)}`;
}

function formatDate(iso?: string): string {
  if (!iso) return '—';
  const d = new Date(iso);
  return Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? '—' : d.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR');
}

function formatSeconds(v?: string | number): string {
  const n = typeof v === 'string' ? Number(v) : v;
  if (n === undefined || n === null || Number.isNaN(n)) return '—';
  const min = Math.floor(n / 60);
  const s = Math.round(n % 60);
  return `${min}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

function privacyBadge(status?: string) {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {
    public: 'border-cyan-500/40 text-cyan-300 bg-cyan-500/10',
    unlisted: 'border-amber-500/40 text-amber-300 bg-amber-500/10',
    private: 'border-zinc-500/40 text-zinc-300 bg-zinc-500/10',
  };
  return map[status ?? ''] ?? 'border-zinc-500/40 text-zinc-300 bg-zinc-500/10';
}

// ── Edit video dialog (Fatia 2 — força youtube.force-ssl via videos.update) ──────
function EditVideoDialog({ video, onClose }: { video: YouTubeVideo | null; onClose: () => void }) {
  const update = useUpdateVideo();
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');

  // Seed the fields when a video is opened (keyed remount via `key` on the caller keeps this simple).
  // biome-ignore lint/correctness/useExhaustiveDependencies: <explanation>
  useMemo(() => {
    setTitle(video?.snippet?.title ?? '');
    setDescription(video?.snippet?.description ?? '');
  }, [video]);

  if (!video) return null;
  const save = async () => {
    try {
      await update.mutateAsync({ videoId: video.id, title: title.trim(), description });
      toast.success('Vídeo atualizado no YouTube.');
      onClose();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error((e as Error).message);
    }
  };
  return (
    <Dialog open={!!video} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && onClose()}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-lg">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Editar vídeo</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>Altera o título e a descrição direto no seu canal do YouTube (videos.update).</DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <Label htmlFor="yt-title">Título</Label>
            <Input id="yt-title" value={title} onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)} maxLength={100} />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <Label htmlFor="yt-desc">Descrição</Label>
            <Textarea id="yt-desc" value={description} onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)} rows={5} maxLength={5000} />
          </div>
        </div>
        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={onClose} disabled={update.isPending}>Cancelar</Button>
          <Button onClick={save} disabled={update.isPending || !title.trim()} className="gap-2">
            {update.isPending ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <Pencil className="h-4 w-4" />}
            Salvar no YouTube
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

        <TableCell className="font-mono text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{v.id}</TableCell>
        {hasWriteScope && (

              <Button
                variant="ghost" size="icon"
                className="h-7 w-7 text-destructive hover:text-destructive"
                title="Excluir permanentemente"
                onClick={() => onDelete(v)}
              >
                <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              </Button>
            </div>
          </TableCell>
        )}
      </TableRow>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <Card className="border-cyan-500/20 bg-cyan-500/5">
        <CardHeader className="pb-0">
          <CardTitle className="text-base">Vídeos do canal ({videos?.length ?? 0}{hasNextPage ? '+' : ''})</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {isLoading ? (
            <Skeleton className="h-96 w-full rounded-xl" />
          ) : isError ? (
            <div className="text-sm text-amber-300">
              Falha ao carregar vídeos: {(error as Error)?.message}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <YouTubeUploadPanel />
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <h2 className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Seus vídeos</h2>
                <Table>
                  <TableHeader>
                    <TableRow>
                      {COLUMNS.map((col) => (
                        <TableHeader key={col} className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">{col}</TableHeader>
                      ))}
                    </TableRow>
                  </TableHeader>
                  <TableBody>
                    {videos?.map((v) => (
                      <VideoRow
                        key={v.id}
                        v={v}
                        onEdit={(video) => setEditVideo(video)}
                        onDelete={(video) => setDeletedVideo(video)}
                      />
                    ))}
                  </TableBody>
                </Table>
                {hasNextPage && (
                  <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => fetchNextPage()}>
                    Carregar mais
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>
            )
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <AlertDialog
        open={!!deletedVideo}
        onOpenChange={(open) => !open && setDeletedVideo(null)}
      >
        <AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogTitle>Excluir vídeo?</AlertDialogTitle>
        </AlertDialogHeader>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogDescription>
            Tem certeza que deseja excluir permanentemente "{deletedVideo?.snippet?.title}" do YouTube?
          </AlertDialogDescription>
        </AlertDialogContent>
        <AlertDialogFooter>
          <AlertDialogCancel>Cancelar</AlertDialogCancel>
          <AlertDialogAction
            onClick={async () => {
              try {
                await deleteVideo.mutateAsync(deletedVideo?.id ?? '');
                toast.success('Vídeo excluído do YouTube.');
                setDeletedVideo(null);
              } catch (e) {
                toast.error((e as Error).message);
              }
            }}
            className="text-destructive"
          >
            Excluir
          </AlertDialogAction>
        </AlertDialogFooter>
      </AlertDialog>

      <EditVideoDialog video={editVideo} onClose={() => setEditVideo(null)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

{isLoading ? (A) : (isError ? (B) : (C))}
```

We have:

  - A
  - ) : (
  - isError ? (
  - B
  - ) : (
  - C
  - )
  - )
  - }

So we have two closing parentheses after the inner ternary: one for the inner ternary's false branch and one for the outer ternary's false branch.

Let's count the parentheses:

- Then we have `) : (` -> this closes the parenthesis after the true branch and opens the parenthesis for the false branch.
- Then we have `isError ? (` -> this opens a parenthesis for the true branch of the inner ternary.
- After `<div>Error</div>` we have `)` -> this closes the parenthesis for the true branch of the inner ternary.
- Then we have `) : (` -> this closes the parenthesis for the true branch of the inner ternary and opens the parenthesis for the false branch of the inner ternary.
- After the `<div>Normal</div>` we have `)` -> this closes the parenthesis for the false branch of the inner ternary.
- Then we have `)` -> this closes the parenthesis for the false branch of the outer ternary.
- Then we have `}` -> this closes the braces for the JSX expression.

So we have:

```

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle } from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription, DialogFooter } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import {
  MonitorPlay,
  RefreshCw,
  AlertTriangle,
  ExternalLink,
  Eye,
  ThumbsUp,
  MessageSquare,
  Users,
  Clock,
  Loader2,
  Pencil,
  Trash2,
  DollarSign,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useYouTubeVideos, useDeleteVideo, useUpdateVideo, type YouTubeVideo } from '@/hooks/useYouTubeStudio';
import { useYouTubeConnection } from '@/hooks/useYouTubeConnection';
import { YouTubeUploadPanel } from '@/components/youtube/YouTubeUploadPanel';

// ── Formatting helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function formatNumber(v?: string | number): string {
  const n = typeof v === 'string' ? Number(v) : v;
  if (n === undefined || n === null || Number.isNaN(n)) return '—';
  if (n >= 1_000_000) return `${(n / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`;
  if (n >= 1_000) return `${(n / 1_000).toFixed(1)}k`;
  return String(n);
}

function formatDuration(iso?: string): string {
  if (!iso) return '—';
  const m = iso.match(/PT(?:(\d+)H)?(?:(\d+)M)?(?:(\d+)S)?/);
  if (!m) return '—';
  const h = Number(m[1] ?? 0);
  const min = Number(m[2] ?? 0);
  const s = Number(m[3] ?? 0);
  const pad = (x: number) => String(x).padStart(2, '0');
  return h > 0 ? `${h}:${pad(min)}:${pad(s)}` : `${min}:${pad(s)}`;
}

function formatDate(iso?: string): string {
  if (!iso) return '—';
  const d = new Date(iso);
  return Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? '—' : d.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR');
}

function formatSeconds(v?: string | number): string {
  const n = typeof v === 'string' ? Number(v) : v;
  if (n === undefined || n === null || Number.isNaN(n)) return '—';
  const min = Math.floor(n / 60);
  const s = Math.round(n % 60);
  return `${min}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

function privacyBadge(status?: string) {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {
    public: 'border-cyan-500/40 text-cyan-300 bg-cyan-500/10',
    unlisted: 'border-amber-500/40 text-amber-300 bg-amber-500/10',
    private: 'border-zinc-500/40 text-zinc-300 bg-zinc-500/10',
  };
  return map[status ?? ''] ?? 'border-zinc-500/40 text-zinc-300 bg-zinc-500/10';
}

// ── Edit video dialog (Fatia 2 — força youtube.force-ssl via videos.update) ──────
function EditVideoDialog({ video, onClose }: { video: YouTubeVideo | null; onClose: () => void }) {
  const update = useUpdateVideo();
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');

  // Seed the fields when a video is opened (keyed remount via `key` on the caller keeps this simple).
  // biome-ignore lint/correctness/useExhaustiveDependencies: <explanation>
  useMemo(() => {
    setTitle(video?.snippet?.title ?? '');
    setDescription(video?.snippet?.description ?? '');
  }, [video]);

  if (!video) return null;
  const save = async () => {
    try {
      await update.mutateAsync({ videoId: video.id, title: title.trim(), description });
      toast.success('Vídeo atualizado no YouTube.');
      onClose();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error((e as Error).message);
    }
  };
  return (
    <Dialog open={!!video} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && onClose()}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-lg">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Editar vídeo</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>Altera o título e a descrição direto no seu canal do YouTube (videos.update).</DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <Label htmlFor="yt-title">Título</Label>
            <Input id="yt-title" value={title} onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)} maxLength={100} />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <Label htmlFor="yt-desc">Descrição</Label>
            <Textarea id="yt-desc" value={description} onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)} rows={5} maxLength={5000} />
          </div>
        </div>
        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={onClose} disabled={update.isPending}>Cancelar</Button>
          <Button onClick={save} disabled={update.isPending || !title.trim()} className="gap-2">
            {update.isPending ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <Pencil className="h-4 w-4" />}
            Salvar no YouTube
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

export function ChannelVideosCard() {
  const { data: videos, isLoading, isError, error, hasNextPage, fetchNextPage } = useYouTubeVideos();
  const { hasWriteScope } = useYouTubeConnection();
  const deleteVideo = useDeleteVideo();
  const [deletedVideo, setDeletedVideo] = useState<YouTubeVideo | null>(null);
  const [editVideo, setEditVideo] = useState<YouTubeVideo | null>(null);

  const COLUMNS = [
    'Vídeo', 'Publicado', 'Privacidade', 'Upload', 'Duração', 'Def',
    'Views', 'Likes', 'Coment.', 'Tags', 'Cat.', 'Kids', 'Licença', 'Embed', 'Sintético', 'ID',
  ];

  function VideoRow({
    v, onEdit, onDelete,
  }: {
    v: YouTubeVideo;
    onEdit: (v: YouTubeVideo) => void;
    onDelete: (v: YouTubeVideo) => void;
  }) {
    const thumb = v.snippet?.thumbnails?.default?.url ?? v.snippet?.thumbnails?.medium?.url;
    return (
      <TableRow>
        <TableCell className="min-w-[280px]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            {thumb ? (
              <img src={thumb} alt="" className="h-10 w-16 flex-shrink-0 rounded object-cover" loading="lazy" />
            ) : (
              <div className="h-10 w-16 flex-shrink-0 rounded bg-muted" />
            )}
            <div className="min-w-0">
              {/* O título navega para a página de análise do vídeo (interna), não para o YouTube. */}
              <a
                href={`/dashboard/youtube/studio-yt/video/${v.id}`}
                className="line-clamp-2 text-sm font-medium hover:text-cyan-300"
              >
                {v.snippet?.title ?? '(sem título)'}
              </a>
            </div>
          </div>
        </TableCell>
        <TableCell className="whitespace-nowrap text-xs text-muted-foreground">{formatDate(v.snippet?.publishedAt)}</TableCell>
        <TableCell>
          <Badge variant="outline" className={privacyBadge(v.status?.privacyStatus)}>
            {v.status?.privacyStatus ?? '—'}
          </Badge>
        </TableCell>
        <TableCell className="whitespace-nowrap text-xs">{v.status?.uploadStatus ?? '—'}</TableCell>
        <TableCell className="whitespace-nowrap tabular-nums text-xs">{formatDuration(v.contentDetails?.duration)}</TableCell>
        <TableCell className="text-xs uppercase">{v.contentDetails?.definition ?? '—'}</TableCell>
        <TableCell className="tabular-nums">{formatNumber(v.statistics?.viewCount)}</TableCell>
        <TableCell className="tabular-nums">{formatNumber(v.statistics?.likeCount)}</TableCell>
        <TableCell className="tabular-nums">{formatNumber(v.statistics?.commentCount)}</TableCell>
        <TableCell className="tabular-nums text-xs">{v.snippet?.tags?.length ?? 0}</TableCell>
        <TableCell className="text-xs">{v.snippet?.categoryId ?? '—'}</TableCell>
        <TableCell className="text-xs">{v.status?.madeForKids ? 'Sim' : 'Não'}</TableCell>
        <TableCell className="text-xs">{v.status?.license ?? '—'}</TableCell>
        <TableCell className="text-xs">{v.status?.embeddable ? 'Sim' : 'Não'}</TableCell>
        <TableCell className="text-xs">{v.status?.containsSyntheticMedia ? 'Sim' : '—'}</TableCell>
        <TableCell className="font-mono text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{v.id}</TableCell>
        {hasWriteScope && (
          <TableCell className="whitespace-nowrap">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7" title="Editar" onClick={() => onEdit(v)}>
                <Pencil className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="ghost" size="icon"
                className="h-7 w-7 text-destructive hover:text-destructive"
                title="Excluir permanentemente"
                onClick={() => onDelete(v)}
              >
                <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              </Button>
            </div>
          </TableCell>
        )}
      </TableRow>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <Card className="border-cyan-500/20 bg-cyan-500/5">
        <CardHeader className="pb-0">
          <CardTitle className="text-base">Vídeos do canal ({videos?.length ?? 0}{hasNextPage ? '+' : ''})</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {isLoading ? (
            <Skeleton className="h-96 w-full rounded-xl" />
          ) : (
            isError ? (
              <div className="text-sm text-amber-300">
                Falha ao carregar vídeos: {(error as Error)?.message}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <YouTubeUploadPanel />
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <h2 className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Seus vídeos</h2>
                  <Table>
                    <TableHeader>
                      <TableRow>
                        {COLUMNS.map((col) => (
                          <TableHeader key={col} className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">{col}</TableHeader>
                        ))}
                      </TableRow>
                    </TableHeader>
                    <TableBody>
                      {videos?.map((v) => (
                        <VideoRow
                          key={v.id}
                          v={v}
                          onEdit={(video) => setEditVideo(video)}
                          onDelete={(video) => setDeletedVideo(video)}
                        />
                      ))}
                    </TableBody>
                  </Table>
                  {hasNextPage && (
                    <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => fetchNextPage()}>
                      Carregar mais
                    </Button>
                  )}
                </div>
              )
            )
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <AlertDialog
        open={!!deletedVideo}
        onOpenChange={(open) => !open && setDeletedVideo(null)}
      >
        <AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogTitle>Excluir vídeo?</AlertDialogTitle>
        </AlertDialogHeader>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogDescription>
            Tem certeza que deseja excluir permanentemente "{deletedVideo?.snippet?.title}" do YouTube?
          </AlertDialogDescription>
        </AlertDialogContent>
        <AlertDialogFooter>
          <AlertDialogCancel>Cancelar</AlertDialogCancel>
          <AlertDialogAction
            onClick={async () => {
              try {
                await deleteVideo.mutateAsync(deletedVideo?.id ?? '');
                toast.success('Vídeo excluído do YouTube.');
                setDeletedVideo(null);
              } catch (e) {
                toast.error((e as Error).message);
              }
            }}
            className="text-destructive"
          >
            Excluir
          </AlertDialogAction>
        </AlertDialogFooter>
      </AlertDialog>

      <EditVideoDialog video={editVideo} onClose={() => setEditVideo(null)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

```bash
# 1a. Secret leak scan — check staged + working tree for hardcoded credentials
git diff HEAD | grep -E "(sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}|AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35}|eyJ[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{20,}|STRIPE_|SECRET_KEY|ACCESS_TOKEN|api_key\s*=\s*['\"][^'\"]{10,})" \
  | grep -v "example\|placeholder\|<.*>\|your-key\|YOUR_" | head -20

# 1b. Edge function JWT enforcement — every user-facing function must verify JWT
grep -rL "Authorization\|jwt\|JWT\|service_role" supabase/functions/*/index.ts \
  | grep -v "get-infra-status\|watchdog" || echo "ALL FUNCTIONS: JWT enforced ✅"

# 1c. Client-side coin deduction guard — must NEVER update mco_balance directly from client

# 1d. RLS bypass risk — check for supabase.rpc calls without auth context

# 1e. Sensitive data in console.log
grep -rn "console\.log.*token\|console\.log.*key\|console\.log.*secret\|console\.log.*password" src/ \
  | head -10 || echo "NO SENSITIVE LOGS ✅"

**Security verdict:** list each check as ✅ PASS / ⚠️ WARN / 🔴 BLOCK.

### DOCUMENTATION CREDENTIAL RULE (invariant — never violate)

**When writing HANDOFF.md, README.md, or any committed documentation:**

- ✅ DO: describe WHERE a credential is stored → `VITE_GEMINI_API_KEY` is set in `.env` (local) and `GEMINI_API_KEY` in the Supabase vault
- ✅ DO: reference digest/fingerprint if useful → `GEMINI_API_KEY (digest 0fe0e159...)`
- 🔴 NEVER: include the actual credential value → `AIzaSyBv...`, `sk-...`, `eyJ...`

> **Rationale:** Phase 1 scans changes that predate the HANDOFF.md write. Any credential embedded
> in HANDOFF.md during Phase 5 escapes Phase 1 entirely and goes directly to the remote.
> This rule is the primary prevention layer; Phase 5b is the detection backstop.

## PHASE 6 — BoK SEAL STATUS (mandatory before push)

**Verify any significant module work in this session has a sealed BoK suite per CLAUDE.md MCORCH Master Execution Protocol.**

```bash
# 6-1. List BoK suites present + check completeness
for slug in $(ls docs/bok/ 2>/dev/null); do
  required=(00-index 01-mrd 02-brd 03-prd 04-frd 05-sdd 06-data-model 07-process-flow 08-quality-metrics)
  missing=()
  for doc in "${required[@]}"; do
    [ -f "docs/bok/$slug/$doc.md" ] || missing+=("$doc")
  done
  [ ${#missing[@]} -eq 0 ] \
    && echo "✅ $slug — BoK complete (9 docs)" \
    || echo "⚠️ $slug — incomplete (missing: ${missing[*]})"
done

# 6-2. Check session touched code in new src/pages/ or new supabase/functions/ that lacks BoK
session_new_modules=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~10..HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^(src/pages/|supabase/functions/|src/components/[A-Z])" | awk -F/ '{print $1"/"$2}' | sort -u)
echo "Session touched modules: $session_new_modules"

# 6-3. Mesh seal nodes for sealed BoK suites
source .env 2>/dev/null
if [ -n "$SB_SECRET_KEY" ]; then
  curl -s "$SUPABASE_URL/rest/v1/mcorch_nodes?node_type=eq.documentation_suite&select=id,name,stability_score,created_at" \
    -H "apikey: $SB_SECRET_KEY" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $SB_SECRET_KEY" \
    | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(f\"  🌐 {n['name']} ({n['stability_score']})\") for n in d]" 2>/dev/null \
    || echo "  ⚠️ Could not query seal nodes"
fi
```

**Gate verdict:**
- ✅ All session modules have sealed BoK → proceed to Phase 7 push.
- ⚠️ Module work without BoK (e.g. `feat:` commit creating new page/edge fn without `docs/bok/<slug>/`)
  → 🔴 **BLOCK seal**. Run `/bok-scribe <module>` first OR add module to exemption list (typo/dep bump/single-file patch).

Report BoK status in final seal output (Phase 8).

## PHASE 1 — SECURITY AUDIT

Run these checks and report findings. **Block the seal if any CRITICAL finding exists.**

> ⚠️ **SCOPE NOTE:** This phase scans changes that exist NOW (before Phase 5 writes HANDOFF.md).
> A second mandatory scan runs in Phase 5b, after HANDOFF.md is written and before it is committed.

```bash
# 1a. Secret leak scan — check staged + working tree for hardcoded credentials
git diff HEAD | grep -E "(sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}|AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35}|eyJ[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{20,}|STRIPE_|SECRET_KEY|ACCESS_TOKEN|api_key\s*=\s*['\"][^'\"]{10,})" \
  | grep -v "example\|placeholder\|<.*>\|your-key\|YOUR_" | head -20

# 1b. Edge function JWT enforcement — every user-facing function must verify JWT
grep -rL "Authorization\|jwt\|JWT\|service_role" supabase/functions/*/index.ts \
  | grep -v "get-infra-status\|watchdog" || echo "ALL FUNCTIONS: JWT enforced ✅"

# 1c. Client-side coin deduction guard — must NEVER update mco_balance directly from client
grep -rn "mco_balance.*update\|UPDATE.*mco_balance" src/ \
  | grep -v "settings\|top.up\|topup\|SettingsPage" | head -10 || echo "NO VIOLATIONS ✅"

# 1d. RLS bypass risk — check for supabase.rpc calls without auth context
grep -rn "service_role\|bypass.*rls\|rls.*bypass" src/ | head -10 || echo "NO VIOLATIONS ✅"

# 1e. Sensitive data in console.log
grep -rn "console\.log.*token\|console\.log.*key\|console\.log.*secret\|console\.log.*password" src/ \
  | head -10 || echo "NO SENSITIVE LOGS ✅"
```

**Security verdict:** list each check as ✅ PASS / ⚠️ WARN / 🔴 BLOCK.
Only proceed if no 🔴 findings.

### DOCUMENTATION CREDENTIAL RULE (invariant — never violate)

**When writing HANDOFF.md, README.md, or any committed documentation:**

- ✅ DO: describe WHERE a credential is stored → `VITE_GEMINI_API_KEY` is set in `.env` (local) and `GEMINI_API_KEY` in the Supabase vault
- ✅ DO: reference digest/fingerprint if useful → `GEMINI_API_KEY (digest 0fe0e159...)`
- 🔴 NEVER: include the actual credential value → `AIzaSyBv...`, `sk-...`, `eyJ...`

> **Rationale:** Phase 1 scans changes that predate the HANDOFF.md write. Any credential embedded
> in HANDOFF.md during Phase 5 escapes Phase 1 entirely and goes directly to the remote.
> This rule is the primary prevention layer; Phase 5b is the detection backstop.

## PHASE 6 — BoK SEAL STATUS (mandatory before push)

**Verify any significant module work in this session has a sealed BoK suite per CLAUDE.md MCORCH Master Execution Protocol.**

```bash
# 6-1. List BoK suites present + check completeness
for slug in $(ls docs/bok/ 2>/dev/null); do
  required=(00-index 01-mrd 02-brd 03-prd 04-frd 05-sdd 06-data-model 07-process-flow 08-quality-metrics)
  missing=()
  for doc in "${required[@]}"; do
    [ -f "docs/bok/$slug/$doc.md" ] || missing+=("$doc")
  done
  [ ${#missing[@]} -eq 0 ] \
    && echo "✅ $slug — BoK complete (9 docs)" \
    || echo "⚠️ $slug — incomplete (missing: ${missing[*]})"
done

# 6-2. Check session touched code in new src/pages/ or new supabase/functions/ that lacks BoK
session_new_modules=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~10..HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^(src/pages/|supabase/functions/|src/components/[A-Z])" | awk -F/ '{print $1"/"$2}' | sort -u)
echo "Session touched modules: $session_new_modules"

# 6-3. Mesh seal nodes for sealed BoK suites
source .env 2>/dev/null
if [ -n "$SB_SECRET_KEY" ]; then
  curl -s "$SUPABASE_URL/rest/v1/mcorch_nodes?node_type=eq.documentation_suite&select=id,name,stability_score,created_at" \
    -H "apikey: $SB_SECRET_KEY" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $SB_SECRET_KEY" \
    | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(f\"  🌐 {n['name']} ({n['stability_score']})\") for n in d]" 2>/dev/null \
    || echo "  ⚠️ Could not query seal nodes"
fi
```

**Gate verdict:**
- ✅ All session modules have sealed BoK → proceed to Phase 7 push.
- ⚠️ Module work without BoK (e.g. `feat:` commit creating new page/edge fn without `docs/bok/<slug>/`)
  → 🔴 **BLOCK seal**. Run `/bok-scribe <module>` first OR add module to exemption list (typo/dep bump/single-file patch).

Report BoK status in final seal output (Phase 8).

(`git cat-file`), mesh UUIDs (`mcorch_nodes`/`mcorch_edges`), `tsc --noEmit`, the test suite,
edge-function reachability, file paths — then prints a Proof Manifest table and exits.

**Gate verdict:**
- **exit 0 — `SEAL ALLOWED`** → embed the Proof Manifest in the Phase 8 report (`📋 PROVA MATERIAL`); proceed to Phase 6.
- **exit 1 — `SEAL BLOCKED`** → 🔴 **BLOCK the seal.** Do NOT push. For each 🔴, fix the real
  cause — never fabricate proof (Law 1) — and re-run this phase until `SEAL ALLOWED`. If a 🔴 is a
  strict handoff-node claim, re-attempt the Phase 3 insert once (SOP Cenário D), then re-run.
- `⏭ skip` rows (infra unreachable · non-mesh UUID · size-only deploy) never block — report them.

## PHASE 6 — BoK SEAL STATUS (mandatory before push)

**Verify any significant module work in this session has a sealed BoK suite per CLAUDE.md MCORCH Master Execution Protocol.**

```bash
# 6-1. List BoK suites present + check completeness
for slug in $(ls docs/bok/ 2>/dev/null); do
  required=(00-index 01-mrd 02-brd 03-prd 04-frd 05-sdd 06-data-model 07-process-flow 08-quality-metrics)
  missing=()
  for doc in "${required[@]}"; do
    [ -f "docs/bok/$slug/$doc.md" ] || missing+=("$doc")
  done
  [ ${#missing[@]} -eq 0 ] \
    && echo "✅ $slug — BoK complete (9 docs)" \
    || echo "⚠️ $slug — incomplete (missing: ${missing[*]})"
done

# 6-2. Check session touched code in new src/pages/ or new supabase/functions/ that lacks BoK
session_new_modules=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~10..HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^(src/pages/|supabase/functions/|src/components/[A-Z])" | awk -F/ '{print $1"/"$2}' | sort -u)
echo "Session touched modules: $session_new_modules"

# 6-3. Mesh seal nodes for sealed BoK suites
source .env 2>/dev/null
if [ -n "$SB_SECRET_KEY" ]; then
  curl -s "$SUPABASE_URL/rest/v1/mcorch_nodes?node_type=eq.documentation_suite&select=id,name,stability_score,created_at" \
    -H "apikey: $SB_SECRET_KEY" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $SB_SECRET_KEY" \
    | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(f\"  🌐 {n['name']} ({n['stability_score']})\") for n in d]" 2>/dev/null \
    || echo "  ⚠️ Could not query seal nodes"
fi
```

**Gate verdict:**
- ✅ All session modules have sealed BoK → proceed to Phase 7 push.
- ⚠️ Module work without BoK (e.g. `feat:` commit creating new page/edge fn without `docs/bok/<slug>/`)
  → 🔴 **BLOCK seal**. Run `/bok-scribe <module>` first OR add module to exemption list (typo/dep bump/single-file patch).

Report BoK status in final seal output (Phase 8).

> 90	
> 91	- **Grounding do chat AIOS Core-Fable consertado (a raiz de "algo errado no ecossistema"):** o AIOS confabulava arquitetura inexistente (monorepo/tabelas/`ffmpeg.wasm`) com confiança de autoridade. ### 🏗️ Arquitetura Entregue (Harness Engineering — Lei 1/2/4)

```
YouTubeStudioPage.tsx (header L443)
  ├─ "Publicar" button → pubTab='video' → YouTubePublishModal.open
  ├─ "Histórico" button → pubTab='historico' → YouTubePublishModal.open

       └─ Tab "Histórico" → ChannelVideosCard.tsx
            ├─ useYouTubeVideos()          (useInfiniteQuery → youtube-data edge fn)
            ├─ useYouTubeConnection()      (hasWriteScope gate)
            ├─ useUpdateVideo()            (videos.update force-ssl)
            └─ useDeleteVideo()            (videos.delete)
```
